title: Implement schema import orchestration UI
description: Create the UI for importing a PostgreSQL schema as a diagram, including schema selection and import trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select a schema to import
Import trigger sends request to backend
Import progress/status is displayed to user

BUG FOUND in src/components/SchemaImportSelector.tsx: handleCustomSchemaChange writes to `schema` instead of `customSchema`, and showCustomInput = (schema === ''). When a user selects 'Other…' (schema='') and types a custom name, the first keystroke sets schema to non-empty, unmounting the custom input immediately. The customSchema state is never updated or read (dead state). A user cannot enter a custom schema name.

Required fix: (a) handleCustomSchemaChange should call setCustomSchema(event.target.value) not setSchema; (b) keep showCustomInput = (schema === '') so the input stays visible while typing; (c) import should use effective schema = customSchema || schema || 'public'; (d) add a test covering custom schema entry via the 'Other…' input.
